enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed on his back. Pull the duvet up to the shoulders. Close eyes. Stay still. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the left side. Pull the pillow down under the head. Tuck the arm under the pillow. Remain motionless. Turn onto the right side. Push the duvet down with one hand. Pull the duvet back up. Lie still on the back. Keep eyes closed. Remain asleep until the phone alarm sounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, checking online university portal, reviewing schedule, and setting reminders for appointments while waiting for the shared bathroom to free up.
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Reach to the bedside table. Pick up the phone. Press the side button to wake the screen. Swipe up to unlock. Tap the university portal app icon. Scroll through the dashboard. Tap the timetable tab. Read the lecture list. Tap back to the home screen. Open the calendar app. Tap the appointment entry. Press the reminder button. Set the alert for 30 minutes before. Tap save. Put the phone down on the bed. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stretch both arms upward. Swing legs to the floor. Place both feet on the floor. Listen at the door for the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Counting cash and setting aside bill money for upcoming expenses, keeping quiet while others use the bathroom and kitchen.
enriched_activities.desc: Reach into the backpack beside the desk. Pull out the wallet. Open the wallet. Take out the notes. Lay the notes flat on the bed. Sort notes into piles by value. Count the $50 notes one by one. Count the $20 notes one by one. Count the $10 notes one by one. Count the coins into a separate pile. Pick up the phone. Open the banking app. Check the account balance on screen. Count out the bill money for rent. Set the bill money aside in an envelope. Mark the amount on the envelope with a pen. Slide the remaining cash back into the wallet. Close the wallet. Put the wallet back in the backpack. Zip the backpack closed. Sit quietly on the bed and wait for the bathroom door to open.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing and taking daily medication after Member 4's shower slot.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 5 to the bathroom door. Push the bathroom door open. Step inside. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water onto the face. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap between the hands. Lather the face. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Dry the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water from the cup. Turn on the tap. Rinse the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Open the toiletry bag. Take out the medication blister pack. Push one tablet through the foil. Place the tablet on the tongue. Fill the cup with water. Swallow the tablet with water. Put the blister pack back in the toiletry bag. Zip the toiletry bag closed. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Quick transition and gathering study materials.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 5. Pick up the laptop from the desk. Slide the laptop into the backpack. Pick up the notebook from the desk. Put the notebook in the backpack. Pick up the pen and drop it in the front pocket. Pick up the phone from the bed. Put the phone in the pocket. Pick up the backpack by the strap. Turn towards the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and drinking tea (skips breakfast) after the kitchen frees up.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 5 to the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Put the backpack down on a chair. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Take out a tea bag. Put the mug on the counter. Drop the tea bag into the mug. Open the kettle lid. Fill the kettle at the tap. Close the kettle lid. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch on. Wait for the water to boil. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into the mug. Put the kettle back on the base. Pick up a spoon. Stir the tea bag in the mug. Take the tea bag out with the spoon. Drop the tea bag in the bin. Pick up the mug. Sip the tea. Drink the tea while standing at the counter. Rinse the mug in the sink. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending online lectures and studying for business degree.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 5. Close the door. Put the backpack on the floor next to the desk. Sit on the chair. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Wait for the laptop to start. Pick up the phone. Check the lecture link in the unit group chat. Type the meeting code into the browser. Click join. Turn on the laptop microphone. Turn on the laptop camera. Open the notebook. Pick up the pen. Write the lecture heading. Write notes on the slide content. Click the slide advance button. Write further notes. Open the unit reading PDF in a second browser tab. Scroll through the reading. Highlight a paragraph with the cursor. Type notes into the assignment document. Press save. Stop the camera. Leave the meeting. Close the laptop lid. Turn off the desk lamp. Stand up from the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch with Member 1, Member 2, Member 3, Member 4 and Member 6 in the shared kitchen during the lockdown.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 5 to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the food on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a frying pan. Put the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Press the heat setting button. Pour oil into the pan. Crack two eggs into the pan. Stir the eggs with a spatula. Cut the vegetables on the chopping board with a knife. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir the pan contents. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the food onto a plate. Carry the plate to the kitchen table. Sit down at the table next to Member 1 and Member 3. Pick up the fork. Eat the lunch. Say to Member 6, "Did you hear the lockdown got extended?" Pass the salt shaker to Member 4. Pick up the plate. Carry the plate to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing household chores (dishes, cleaning counters) following written chore chart.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the wall chart. Read the chore chart column for today. Turn on the kitchen tap. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Pick up a plate. Scrub the plate with the sponge. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate on the drying rack. Pick up a bowl. Scrub the bowl. Rinse the bowl. Place the bowl on the drying rack. Pick up the cups and scrub each one. Rinse the cups and place them on the drying rack. Pick up the cutlery and scrub each piece. Rinse the cutlery. Place the cutlery in the rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth. Spray the counter spray on the counter. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Wipe the stove top with the cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring out the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Write a tick next to the chore on the chart with the pen.

enriched_activities.activity: Participating in virtual group project meeting with classmates.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 5. Sit on the chair at the desk. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Wait for the laptop to start. Open the browser. Click the group meeting link. Click join with microphone. Say, "Hi everyone, can you hear me?" Open the shared project document. Scroll to the section assigned to him. Type two paragraphs into the document. Share the screen with the group. Point at the figures with the cursor. Say, "I think we should split the market section here." Take the pen. Write down the tasks assigned to him in the notebook. Click the chat box. Type a summary message. Press send. Leave the meeting. Close the laptop lid. Turn off the desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing studying and working on assignments.
enriched_activities.desc: Open the notebook on the desk. Pick up the pen. Read the assignment instructions on the laptop screen. Scroll down the page. Open the referencing guide in a second tab. Type the first reference into the reference list. Type the second reference into the reference list. Switch to the assignment document. Type a paragraph of the body text. Press save. Scroll back to the top of the document. Re-read the introduction. Type one more sentence into the introduction. Press save again.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea and having a small snack with Member 1 and Member 2.
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk from Bedroom 5 to the kitchen. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Take out a tea bag. Drop the tea bag into the mug. Fill the kettle at the tap. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch on. Wait for the water to boil. Pour hot water into the mug. Open the biscuit packet. Take two biscuits out. Put the biscuits on a small plate. Sit at the kitchen table with Member 1 and Member 2. Sip the tea. Eat the biscuits. Say to Member 2, "How is the design deadline going?" Pick up the plate and mug. Carry them to the sink. Rinse the mug and plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing studying and working on assignments.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk back into Bedroom 5. Sit on the chair. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Wait for the laptop to wake. Open the assignment document. Scroll to the end of the written section. Type the next paragraph. Check the word count in the toolbar. Type another paragraph. Open the lecture slides in a second tab. Copy two lines of content into the notes. Type a summary sentence into the assignment. Press save. Add the third reference to the reference list. Press save again. Close the extra browser tab.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a break, listening to music or watching a show.
enriched_activities.desc: Push the chair back from the desk. Stand up. Pick up the phone from the desk. Unlock the phone. Open the music app. Tap a playlist. Put the headphones on. Press play. Lie down on the bed. Pick up the phone again. Open the video app. Scroll through the list. Tap an episode. Prop the phone against the pillow. Watch the episode. Skip the intro by tapping the screen. Pause the video once to reply to a message. Type a reply and press send. Resume the video. Finish the episode. Take the headphones off. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Place the phone on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing dinner with Member 1, Member 3 and Member 4 in the shared kitchen.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 5 to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out chicken and vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Put the food on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a pot. Fill the pot with water at the tap. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Cut the vegetables on the chopping board with the knife. Slide the vegetables into the pot. Cut the chicken on the board. Add the chicken to the pan. Turn the chicken with a spatula. Add sauce to the pan. Stir the pot with a spoon. Say to Member 4, "Can you pass the oven tray?" Place the tray in the oven. Press the oven dial. Set the timer. Turn off the induction cooker. Pour the food into serving bowls.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the table with Member 1, Member 3 and Member 4.
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the bowls to the kitchen table. Place the bowls in the centre of the table. Pull out a chair. Sit down between Member 1 and Member 4. Pick up the serving spoon. Spoon food onto his plate. Put the spoon down. Pick up the fork. Eat the food. Pick up the water glass. Drink water. Say to Member 3, "How was your clinical placement today?" Listen to Member 3 and nod. Pick up the bowl again. Take a second serving. Eat the second serving. Put the fork down on the plate. Lean back in the chair. Stand up from the table. Carry the plate and fork to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up dishes and wiping down counters with Member 1 and Member 4.
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on the kitchen tap. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Pick up a plate. Scrub the plate. Rinse the plate under the tap. Hand the plate to Member 1. Pick up the next plate and scrub it. Rinse it and pass it to Member 1. Pick up the cutlery and scrub each piece. Rinse the cutlery. Place it on the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth. Spray the counter with the counter spray. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Wipe the table with the cloth. Rinse the cloth. Wring the cloth out. Hang the cloth on the hook. Push the chairs back under the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time, video calling friends or family.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the kitchen to Bedroom 5. Close the door. Sit on the bed. Pick up the phone from the desk. Unlock the phone. Open the video call app. Tap the family contact. Press the call button. Wait for the call to connect. Wave at the screen. Say, "Hey, how is everyone?" Hold the phone up while talking. Answer a question about university. Say, "Exams are online this semester." Laugh at the screen. Turn the phone to show the room. Turn the phone back. Listen to the family member speak. Nod the head. Press the end call button. Open the messages app. Type a text message to a friend. Press send. Put the phone down on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading before bed.
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the bed. Walk to the desk. Pick up the novel from the desk. Turn on the space heater with the control knob. Walk back to the bed. Sit on the bed. Lean back against the pillow. Open the book to the bookmark. Read the first page. Turn the page with the right hand. Read the next two pages. Turn the page. Shift the legs under the duvet. Read the next chapter. Turn the page again. Close the book. Place the bookmark between the pages. Put the book on the bedside table. Reach over and turn off the space heater. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening routine and taking medication.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 5 to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Step inside. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup the hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Pick up the soap. Lather the hands. Wash the face with the hands. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Dry the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn on the tap. Rinse the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Open the toiletry bag. Take out the medication blister pack. Push one tablet through the foil. Place the tablet on the tongue. Fill the cup with water. Swallow the tablet with water. Put the blister pack back in the toiletry bag. Zip the bag closed. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the bathroom into Bedroom 5. Close the door. Turn off the ceiling light. Walk to the bed in the dark. Pull the duvet back. Lie down on the bed. Pull the duvet up over the body. Adjust the pillow under the head. Turn onto the left side. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the back. Turn onto the right side. Pull the duvet up to the chin. Remain still. Keep eyes closed. Sleep through the rest of the night.
